pairs.ask: Carrier PIN Against SIM Swaps: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Add a port-out PIN with your carrier and switch banks from text codes to app or passkey sign-in. Who does it: Max, With A Guide From Security.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Add a port-out PIN with your carrier</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">and switch banks from text codes to</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">app or passkey sign-in. Who does it:</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Max, With A Guide From Security.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: If someone moves your phone number to their SIM, they get your bank text codes.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A3A3A3"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Not Now</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Leave it for now. Why it matters: If</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">someone moves your phone number to</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">their SIM, they get your bank text</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">codes.</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Lock Down Your Phone And Mac: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Turn on FileVault, auto-lock within 5 minutes, Find My, and automatic updates on both. Who does it: Max, With A Checklist From Security.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Turn on FileVault, auto-lock within 5</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">minutes, Find My, and automatic</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">updates on both. Who does it: Max,</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">With A Checklist From Security.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: Your phone and Mac hold every login. A lost device without encryption exposes everything.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A3A3A3"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Not Now</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Leave it for now. Why it matters: Your</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">phone and Mac hold every login. A lost</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">device without encryption exposes</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">everything.</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Make The Shared Page Password Differ From The Gate: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Grok Bot changes the shared locked-pages password after the gate codes change, so the two always differ. Who does it: Grok Bot.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Grok Bot changes the shared</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">locked-pages password after the gate</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">codes change, so the two always</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">differ. Who does it: Grok Bot.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: The shared locked-pages password is the same as one smartupkeep.ai gate code, so one leak opens both.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A3A3A3"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Not Now</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Leave it for now. Why it matters: The</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">shared locked-pages password is the</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">same as one smartupkeep.ai gate code,</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">so one leak opens both.</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Check The Spending Page Against The Gate Codes: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Security runs the same hash-only check on the Spending page, without printing any values. Who does it: Security.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Security runs the same hash-only check</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">on the Spending page, without printing</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">any values. Who does it: Security.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: The gate codes were checked against the portfolio page and none of them unlock it. The Spending page was not tested.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A3A3A3"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Not Now</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Leave it for now. Why it matters: The</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">gate codes were checked against the</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">portfolio page and none of them unlock</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">it. The Spending page was not tested.</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Retire All Gate Codes When The Real Login Goes Live: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: When Cloudflare Access is confirmed working, UpKeep removes the gate and all nine codes. Removing a person then just means removing their email. Who does it: UpKeep, With Your OK.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">When Cloudflare Access is confirmed</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">working, UpKeep removes the gate and</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">all nine codes. Removing a person then</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">just means removing their email. Who</text><text x="18" y="168" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">does it: UpKeep, With Your OK.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: Treat all nine gate codes (u1 to u9) as compromised: they are short and their hashes sit in a public file.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A3A3A3"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Not Now</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Leave it for now. Why it matters:</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Treat all nine gate codes (u1 to u9)</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">as compromised: they are short and</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">their hashes sit in a public file.</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Change The smartupkeep.ai Gate Passwords: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: UpKeep sets new ones (or moves to the real login you already approved) and shares them privately. Who does it: UpKeep, With Your OK.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">UpKeep sets new ones (or moves to the</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">real login you already approved) and</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">shares them privately. Who does it:</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">UpKeep, With Your OK.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: All nine smartupkeep.ai gate passwords sat in plain text in the password index. Scrubbed now, still exposed.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A3A3A3"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Not Now</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Leave it for now. pairs.ask: Spot Fake Invoices And Phishing: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: A one-page guide: call back on a known number before paying any new bank details, and never log in from an email link. Who does it: Security.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">A one-page guide: call back on a known</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">number before paying any new bank</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">details, and never log in from an</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">email link. Who does it: Security.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: Contractors, tenants and banks email you about money. A fake invoice or login page is the most common way small businesses lose money.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A3A3A3"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Not Now</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Leave it for now. Why it matters:</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Contractors, tenants and banks email</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">you about money. A fake invoice or</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">login page is the most common way</text><text x="18" y="168" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">small businesses lose money.</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Set Up 1Password: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Set up 1Password, then agents get vault access instead of raw passwords and new passwords go straight into it. Who does it: You.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Set up 1Password, then agents get</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">vault access instead of raw passwords</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">and new passwords go straight into it.</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Who does it: You.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: Agents still get raw passwords because there is no shared vault yet. It is on the tracker as waiting on you.

pairs.ask: Keep The Password Manager Emergency Kit Offline: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Export the password manager emergency kit and keep it offline with your recovery codes. Who does it: You.

pairs.ask: Change The Shared Page And Portfolio Passwords: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
